text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The annual 'Spring Umamusume Traffic 
Safety Class.' Symboli Kris S and Mihono 
Bourbon were chosen as the instructors, 
however—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Now then—let our training begin. Are 
you... ready?

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: (...*flinch!*)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
From there... too far... to teach. A 
little more... come closer.

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
—H-Hey... you go in front... —No, you go 
ahead, it's fine...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reviewing instructional process. 
Calculating predictable response patterns 
to determine optimal solution――

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Pattern...? Hey, hey, big sis. Are you a 
robot by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I've seen one on TV before! A robot that 
talks just like that!

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You know those robots at restaurants that 
carry food around? This one's a robot that 
teaches traffic safety!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Children's interest level, up by 120%... 
This is...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for pointing that out. I am 
"Mihono Bourbon: KO-2."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is a robot developed to teach traffic 
rules to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
—Waaah, I knew it! —Incredible, that's so 
amaaazing!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon... You're really... exceptionally 
popular, aren't you...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I referenced the children's status and 
selected the method deemed most effective.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A robot beloved by them—I figured that 
would make it easier for them to accept 
its guidance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: A beloved... robot...

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Is that big sis a robot too? A 
robot?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I am—...

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: (So thrilling...! So sparkling...!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I am—............ 'Symboli Kris S: 
ZK-0.'"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
A robot developed... to guide you all. 
...Pleased... to meet you......... robo.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"KO-2 sensors activated. Measuring roadway 
status. —Pedestrian signal, all green."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Even at a green light—be careful. —Watch 
out... for cars............ Robo."

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Yeeeeeess!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, by pretending to be a robot, the 
traffic safety workshop went swimmingly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Kris S-san. I'm going to go 
pack up the equipment.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I leave it in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Mission Accomplished―― I was able 
to――teach the students properly, but..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks to Bourbon's quick thinking this 
time, I was able to get them interested.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
As a means of fulfilling my mission... I 
am also considering... nurturing the next 
generation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So――……I might need them. Communication 
skills, even more than now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Symboli Kris S learned a vital 
lesson for the future. Watching her 
reflect and grow leaves me in awe.
choice_data_list:
In that case, let's do our best, even if 
it's step by step.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I swear... I will get results—...
